description: Permanently destroy a website, app, agent, or skill. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. Pass kind to say which you mean; a name holding another kind is then refused rather than destroyed. Destroying a website or app stops serving it. Destroying an app stops it and removes its releases and source; its resources are detached and kept, because they belong to the organization and may serve other apps, and the answer names them for destroy_resource. Destroying an agent stops it and removes its channels, agent-scoped connectors, drains, mailboxes, releases, and source repository; none of those can be recovered. Its sessions and memories remain, and once the agent is gone no MCP tool can remove them, so call destroy_session and destroy_memory first if they should go. The architect agent cannot be destroyed. Destroying a skill removes it from list_skills and frees its name; it is refused while any agent has the skill attached, and the refusal names detach_skill, which frees each one. Destroying a skill under a well-known name, such as governance or design-system, brings back Valet's default for every agent in the organization. A name that no longer exists answers that nothing was destroyed. Identify the service by name, which requires connecting a Valet account.

kind.description: The kind you mean. Omit to destroy whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name to destroy.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: destroy_service

already_gone.description: True when no service held the name before the call, so nothing was destroyed. A repeat of a destroy returns this. Absent otherwise.

detached_resources.description: Names of the resources an app's takedown detached. Each still exists with its data; pass a name to destroy_resource to delete it. Absent for other kinds and for an app with none.

kind.description: Kind destroyed: site, app, agent, or skill. When already_gone is true, the kind passed in the call, or service if none was passed.

name.description: Name of the service that was destroyed, or that was already gone.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

restored_default.description: True when the destroyed skill replaced a built-in skill, so Valet's default answers under its name again for every agent in the organization. Absent otherwise.

url.description: Address that has stopped serving, read before the takedown. Absent for an agent, a skill, a service that had no address, and when already_gone is true.

title: Destroy a website, app, agent, or skill
